extracted.name: Spiced chaat masala parsnips
extracted.description: Add these vibrant parsnips to provide a welcome contrast during a rich Christmas feast or Sunday roast. They also make a great side for any curry.
instruction_lines: Put the red onion and lime juice in a small bowl with a pinch of salt. Using your hands, scrunch together until softened slightly. Set aside.

Heat the air fryer to 180C. Mix the parsnips with the vegetable oil, chaat masala and plenty of salt and pepper. Lay the parsnips in the air fryer in a single layer. Cook for 20-25 mins, shaking halfway through.
Remove from the air fryer, spoon onto a platter, then top with the pink onions and scatter over the coriander.
